en-US.longDescription:
QwenWork is an AI office assistant launched by DingTalk that runs locally and can be summoned at any time.
It supports one-stop generation and editing of office outputs such as data analysis, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and web pages; it offers automatic task decomposition, multi-thread parallel processing, and real-time progress tracking. Integrated with enterprise IM, it covers 25 corporate capabilities including group chats, attendance and approvals, meeting schedules, knowledge bases, and emails. It supports multimodal content understanding and generation, aggregation of professional data sources, as well as customized skills and expert suites, covering diverse roles and work scenarios.

zh-CN.longDescription:
千问办公是钉钉推出的 AI 智能办公助手，在本地运行，随时唤起。
支持数据分析、文档、表格、演示文稿与网页等办公产物的一站式生成与编辑；任务自动拆解、多线并行推进，进度实时跟踪；打通企业 IM，覆盖消息群聊、考勤审批、会议日程、知识库与邮件等 25 项企业能力；支持多模态内容理解与生成、专业数据源聚合接入，以及自定义技能与专家套件，覆盖不同岗位与工作场景。
zh-CN.name: 千问办公
